name: voxcpm
description: OpenBMB VoxCPM2 on Strix Halo: multilingual 48 kHz speech synthesis with voice design and voice cloning

releases.notes: `gufo model install voxcpm2` or `voxcpm2-q8` installs the tested Hugging Face weights or audio.cpp's Q8_0 GGUF (Gufo 0.35.0 or later); synthesis unchanged from 0.1.0. Built on Gufo 0.35.0.
Speech synthesis from the Hugging Face directory or audio.cpp's GGUFs (Q8_0 products on the matrix cores): automatic voice, voice design and voice cloning. Built on Gufo 0.34.0.
